countries.reasoning: Based on World Steel Association 2023 data, China is by far the largest producer of carbon steel and overall crude steel. Data is comprehensive and very reliable.
India is the second largest steel producer, with strong government and industry data from 2023. Known for large carbon steel production shares.
Japan is a traditional large steel producer with well-documented production statistics from the World Steel Association 2023 report.
US steel industry data from AISI and World Steel Association 2023 confirms it as a top producer with stable output.
Russia holds a significant share of global steel production; data from government and industry reports is good, with moderate recent geopolitical uncertainty.
